title: Mycelium Vein
description: The tunnel wall is shot through with thick veins of glowing mycelium, each strand pulsing with bioluminescent light. The network runs deep into the rock — you could spend hours tracing its branches, or harvest what you can reach and move on.

choices.label: Harvest carefully
choices.description: Take your time and extract the fungal fibers properly.

choices.label: Rip the veins out
choices.description: Tear the mycelium free quickly, but risk a spore burst.

choices.label: Look for spore clusters
choices.description: Where mycelium grows thick, spore clusters often form.
